title: Fixed Split Hip Pad and Rear Roller Extension Bench
description: One newly authored complete fixed back-extension-bench exterior. A long diagonal main spine rises from a low rear support towards a high transverse underplate carrying two separate thick inclined hip pads with a genuine centre gap. Two side handles curve down from the high pad support. The lower rear end has a whole horizontal foot platform, an independent raised transverse axle and two full ankle-like rollers separated by the central mounting post. A full low tie and steep front stay triangulate the open frame above two broad transverse ground feet. No long back cushion, seated carriage, weights, hinged seat, or slant-board deck is reused. All new numeric geometry, one complete prop and zero scenes, four opaque solid PBR roles, metres Z up, full horizontal bounds centred and finite feet at ground. No person, animation, rig or interaction.
